about_the_game:
Survive and defend your land against the armored train in this arcade achievement-attack puzzle. Think smart, find the right sequence to create combos by destroying wagons with different bonuses to speed up and boost your cannon, and stop the train before it stops you.

Features:

  • Wagons of different types — each with unique abilities, bonuses, and disadvantages — create a puzzle where you must find the optimal sequence to defeat the train.

  • Upgrade your hero during each match to gain powerful perks.

  • Progress permanently by upgrading your hero’s cannon and equipment to increase firepower and face progressively stronger trains.

  • Confront your enemy: the Armed Train Force General.

  • Beat the train in over 100 levels across 6 unique settings.
